description: Dark Souls: Prepare to Die Edition (single-player, DSCM stripped, via Proton)
long: Dark Souls: Prepare to Die Edition is an action RPG renowned for its punishing difficulty, deliberate combat, and interconnected dark-fantasy world of Lordran. Players manage stamina, learn enemy patterns, and recover lost souls after each death while uncovering cryptic environmental storytelling. This build runs the single-player experience with the multiplayer netcode stripped out.
name: Dark Souls: Prepare to Die Edition
